name: knowledge
description: RAG over local document stores: index markdown/text/html/pdf corpora into named sqlite vector stores, query with natural language, get chunks back with source + heading citations. Embeddings via $LLM_BASE_URL /v1/embeddings.
use_when: answering questions from your own document corpus (RAG)

args.name: add <name> <path>
args.description: Index a file or directory into named store (incremental by content hash).

args.name: query <text> [--store name|*] [--k 6]
args.description: Top-k chunks across stores with source/heading/score.

env.AGENT_EMBED_MODEL: Embedding model id; auto-detected from /v1/models when unset.

stdout: JSON {results: [{store, source, heading, score, text}]} or store info.
notes: PDF support needs pdftotext (poppler-utils); files are skipped with a warning when absent.
